what: A generative instrument for the FM-1. Three FM voices play interlocking rhythms while the screen draws their orbits live: Lissajous figures, polar roses, epicycles. Pick one of four scenes, turn density, phase and FM ratio, and it keeps evolving. Same notes and voices as the web version.
author: Polaris Sound Lab
sounds: own: ORBITA's synthesized FM voices and its 32 DX7 voices, made by Polaris Sound Lab; CC0: the VSCO-2 and VCSL samples kept from Felucca
